english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a mathematical mean or average.

exampleSentences.english: The mean score for this class is eighty.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢班同學嘅平均數係八十分。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 baan1 tung4 hok6 ge3 ping4 gwan1 sou3 hai6 baat3 sap6 fan1

english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an arithmetic mean.

exampleSentences.english: The average for this exam is 75 marks.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今次考試嘅平均數係七十五分。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 ping4 gwan1 sou3 hai6 cat1 sap6 ng5 fan1
